carecall-wifi-manager.service:
[Unit]
Description=CareCall persistent Wi-Fi and phone recovery
Wants=systemd-networkd.service
After=systemd-networkd.service cloud-init-local.service ufw.service
Conflicts=carecall-wifi-aptrial-test.service carecall-wifi-aptrial-guard.service carecall-wifi-aptrial-hostapd.service carecall-wifi-aptrial-dhcp.service carecall-wifi-aptrial-web.service carecall-wifi-aptrial-router.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/carecall-wifi-manager/owner
StartLimitIntervalSec=0
[Service]
Type=notify
NotifyAccess=main
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -B /opt/carecall-wifi-manager/manager.py run
Restart=always
RestartSec=5s
WatchdogSec=120s
TimeoutStartSec=30s
TimeoutStopSec=10s
KillMode=control-group
RuntimeDirectory=carecall-wifi-manager
RuntimeDirectoryMode=0755
RuntimeDirectoryPreserve=yes
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ReadWritePaths=/run /etc/netplan /etc/cloud/cloud.cfg.d /etc/carecall-wifi-manager
StandardOutput=journal
StandardError=null
[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
carecall-wifi-manager-hostapd.service:
[Unit]
Description=CareCall Wi-Fi setup hostapd
BindsTo=carecall-wifi-manager.service
After=carecall-wifi-manager.service systemd-networkd.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/carecall-wifi-manager/owner
[Service]
Type=simple
User=root
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/hostapd /run/carecall-wifi-manager/hostapd.conf
Restart=no
TimeoutStopSec=5s
KillMode=control-group
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ReadWritePaths=/run/carecall-wifi-manager
StandardOutput=null
StandardError=null
carecall-wifi-manager-dhcp.service:
[Unit]
Description=CareCall Wi-Fi setup dhcp
BindsTo=carecall-wifi-manager.service
After=carecall-wifi-manager.service systemd-networkd.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/carecall-wifi-manager/owner
[Service]
Type=simple
User=root
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/dnsmasq --no-daemon --conf-file=/run/carecall-wifi-manager/dnsmasq.conf
Restart=no
TimeoutStopSec=5s
KillMode=control-group
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ReadWritePaths=/run/carecall-wifi-manager
StandardOutput=null
StandardError=null
carecall-wifi-manager-web.service:
[Unit]
Description=CareCall Wi-Fi setup web
BindsTo=carecall-wifi-manager.service
After=carecall-wifi-manager.service systemd-networkd.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/carecall-wifi-manager/owner
[Service]

User=carecall-wifi-web
ExecStart=/usr/bin/python3 -B /opt/carecall-wifi-manager/web.py

UMask=0077

ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes

carecall-wifi-manager-router.service:
[Unit]
Description=CareCall Wi-Fi setup router
BindsTo=carecall-wifi-manager.service
After=carecall-wifi-manager.service systemd-networkd.service
ConditionPathExists=/etc/carecall-wifi-manager/owner
Conflicts=netplan-wpa-wlan0.service carecall-wifi-manager-hostapd.service
[Service]
Type=simple
User=root
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/wpa_supplicant -Dnl80211 -iwlan0 -c/run/carecall-wifi-manager/private/candidate.conf
Restart=no
TimeoutStopSec=5s
KillMode=control-group
UMask=0077
NoNewPrivileges=yes
ProtectSystem=strict
ProtectHome=yes
PrivateTmp=yes
ReadWritePaths=/run/carecall-wifi-manager
StandardOutput=null
StandardError=null
